`Boldonse.eot` is `ppt/fonts/font1.fntdata` extracted from the LibreOffice
`BoldonseFontEmbedded.pptx` sample at revision
`323ed9b7f85871b4316f919086a2af28877f6d15`. The file contains the Boldonse
font in MTX-compressed EOT form. [Original test deck](https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/blob/323ed9b7f85871b4316f919086a2af28877f6d15/sd/qa/unit/data/BoldonseFontEmbedded.pptx)

Boldonse is distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. [Font license](Boldonse-OFL.txt)
